method: FULL group stage complete (72 matches, through Jun 27 M67-72). wc_goals/wc_assists are FACTUAL from data/manual/results.json match notes + golden-boot/assist trackers (planetfootball + ESPN/CBS/NBC live blogs for M67-72) and the fantasy feed roundPoints. wc_minutes are best-estimate from start/sub timing. wc_xg are now REAL Opta-based numbers from the FOX Sports WC2026 player stats table (sorted by xG, pages 1-6), the canonical per-player xG source available without a login; a few players not in FOX's published xG list (Hakimi, Raul Jimenez, James Rodriguez) keep a small role-based estimate, flagged 'xg est' in notes. wc_xa are SHAPED ESTIMATES (FOX/Sofascore/FotMob did not expose a per-player xA decimal via fetch): anchored to actual assists + planetfootball chances-created rank + role; flagged 'xa est'. wc_shots/wc_sot are REAL from the FOX table where the player appears there. teams block (wc_xg_for/against) is REAL FOX team xG (FOX rounds team xGA to integers; sub-0.5 values stored as small positives to stay process-consistent). The model shrinks the club-season per-90 toward these, minutes-weighted, leaning on xG over goals so finishing heat (e.g. Dembele 4 goals on 0.81 xG, Munoz 2 on 0.15, Summerville 2 on 0.13) regresses. Eliminated nations dropped/not refreshed; focus is the 20 R32 sides that supply fantasy picks.

teams._note: U2 opponent-adjusted team form: per nation {wc_xg_for, wc_xg_against, matches, opponents} = REAL FOX/Opta tournament TOTALS across the FULL 3-game group stage (not per-game). FOX rounds team xGA to integers and displays sub-0.5 as 0; those (Spain/Mexico/Argentina/Czechia/SouthKorea) are stored here as small positives to stay goal-difference/process-consistent. The model credits xG-difference vs the strength of opponents faced (beating Curacao != beating France), shrunk by matches, as a SMALL post-calibration strength offset.
